sql:
SELECT 'it''s a test' AS a,
'hello'
'world' AS b
note: single-quoted string with doubled '' escape and adjacent-string concatenation across newline
U&'' unicode literal with explicit UESCAPE clause

sql: SELECT $$dollar quoted$$ AS dq, $tag$nested $$dollar$$ here$tag$ AS dq2
note: dollar-quoted strings: bare $$ and named $tag$ with embedded $$
numeric literals: integer, decimal, scientific, leading-dot, digit-grouped, hex/octal/binary (PG16+)

sql: SELECT B'101' AS bits, X'1FF' AS hex_bits, B'1010'::integer AS bint
note: bit-string literals B'' and X'' and ::integer cast of bit string

sql: SELECT INTERVAL '2 years 3 months 4 days' AS i1, INTERVAL '01:30:00' HOUR TO MINUTE AS i2, INTERVAL '5.5' SECOND(2) AS i3
note: interval literals: verbose, HH:MM:SS with field qualifiers, fractional with precision

sql: SELECT true, false, TRUE AND FALSE, 'yes'::boolean AS b
SELECT ARRAY[1,2,3] AS arr, ROW(1, 'hello', NULL) AS r, NULL::text AS n
note: ARRAY constructor, ROW constructor, NULL with type cast
